judgment.rationale: Both indicators sit at BASIC 1 (rank 0), so direction rests on substantive content, not coordinate order. B1.2.2.1.4 (Reading / Sub-Strand 2: Phonics, under 'Connect sounds to letters and blend letters/syllables in order to read and write') requires blending sounds into simple syllables/words and syllables into words; its LCs are 'Blend sounds to produce simple syllables/words' and 'Blend syllables to produce words'. B1.5.10.1.1 (Using Writing Conventions / Sub-Strand 10: Spelling) requires identifying and spelling simple words correctly, and its parent Content Standard is explicitly 'Use phonics knowledge to spell words' with LC tags including 'phonics'. Sound/syllable blending proficiency is the phonics capability the spelling indicator draws on to encode simple words, so success in the blending indicator supports success in the spelling indicator (second_to_first). This is a pair-specific phonics-to-spelling link, not mere shared 'simple words' wording or a shared BASIC 1 grade parent.
